content: Kavya Iyer contacted insurance agent Vikram Singh to check the status of her travel policy. Vikram informed her that the policy is expired due to a payment processing error. Kavya agreed to pay the total reinstatement cost of 3000 INR (2500 INR premium plus 500 INR fee) and requested Vikram to proceed with the reinstatement and send the updated policy document.

action_items: Send the updated policy document to the customer
